title: Independent verification: six-source dirty-connector identity and recursive invoice
body:
This independently verifies Douglas Colkitt’s PR1185 six-source witness using free associative algebra over F2. The 142-query program and recursive expansion satisfy the identity for arbitrary dirty inputs and noncommuting operators. Verification covers 3,832 primitive calls, 284 call boundaries, ten negative controls, and explicit matrix counterexamples. A separate matrix oracle checks the interpreter. The optimality census and physical supplier remain outside scope; no new kappa is claimed. Credit: Ross Richardson’s PR943/PR934 and retained notices. Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

- Scope: independent verification of one pinned query witness and its heterogeneous recursive expansion; no new bound or census/optimality claim.
- Base: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`; PR1185 source: `4a60772285ce70f6414458f6d3a54948652bbed0`.
- Added evidence: complete free-algebra states at 284 boundaries, all 69 product interfaces, exact per-primitive invoice, six concrete mutation counterexamples, and 1,752 finite matrix basis cases. No predecessor executable is imported.
- Changes are confined to `research/connector-free-algebra-seed79/`; frozen upstream and selected frontier are unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/connector-free-algebra-seed79/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/connector-free-algebra-seed79/test_verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CONNECTOR_FREE_ALGEBRA queries=142 leaves=3832 rows=73 boundaries=284 controls=10`, then five passing test groups. The selected-record source check also passes; no full supplier replay or hosted CI claim.
